card.summary: The Ratepayer Protection Act requires state utility regulators and nonregulated electric utilities to consider adopting a federal standard regarding large-load electricity consumers, specifically data centers and similar facilities. The standard ensures these large customers pay the full cost of any electric system upgrades needed to serve them and provide upfront financial assurances.
